[[File:Electric company manager.png|thumb|250px|Head of security of the Electric company]]
The '''electric company''' is a company that was mentioned in ''[[EP199|Current Events]]''. Their head of security is a [[character of the day]], and the only company representative seen during the episode. They operate a wind turbine facility between [[Ecruteak City]] and [[Olivine City]].

{{an|Brock}} called the Electric company to inform them that {{Ash}} was trapped inside their facility, and their electric lock was broken. {{TRT}}, who had first entered the facility were responsible for the broken security lock, and Ash later entered out of curiosity. The head of security arrived later and managed to repair the security lock, allowing herself, Brock and Misty to locate Ash. The search party exited the power plant after noticing Ash running outside. The head of security and Ash's friends rushed outside in time to see [[Ash's Chikorita]] [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Bayleef}}. After Bayleef freed herself and the plant's {{p|Electabuzz}}, together the Pokémon sent Team Rocket flying. 

Afterwards she thanked Ash and Bayleef for helping to defeat Team Rocket. {{an|Jigglypuff}} appeared and lulled everyone to sleep with its melodic {{m|Sing}}ing, and in anger it scribbled on everyone's faces including the head of security and her Electabuzz.
